mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_finance_metrics ( metric_date, gross_revenue_cents, refund_amount_cents, net_revenue_cents, order_count, refund_count ) VALUES ( #{metricDate}, #{grossRevenueCents}, #{refundAmountCents}, #{netRevenueCents}, #{orderCount}, #{refundCount} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE gross_revenue_cents = gross_revenue_cents + VALUES(gross_revenue_cents), refund_amount_cents = refund_amount_cents + VALUES(refund_amount_cents), net_revenue_cents = net_revenue_cents + VALUES(net_revenue_cents), order_count = order_count + VALUES(order_count), refund_count = refund_count + VALUES(refund_count), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
